name: fbi_get_offense_data
description:
NIBRS incident detail for one offense and year, nationally or for a state (victim and offender age, sex, race; weapons; locations; relationships), from the FBI Crime Data Explorer.
Returns: offense_type, nibrs_offense_code, year, scope, state, total_offenses, rate_per_100k, nibrs_population_coverage_pct, metadata and breakdown {victim, offender, offense}: each category's largest non-zero buckets.
Inputs (* required): offense_type* (homicide, rape, robbery, aggravated_assault, simple_assault, burglary, motor_vehicle_theft, arson, kidnapping, identity_theft); state (two-letter code; omit for national); year (1985 to the current year; default last year); include_subcategories (breakdown on/off; default true); top_n (buckets kept, 1-100; default 10).
For summarized counts and rates use fbi_get_national_statistics or fbi_get_state_statistics. Key: api.data.gov key in FBI_API_KEY, else the rate-limited DEMO_KEY.
Example: {"offense_type": "robbery", "state": "CA", "year": 2022, "top_n": 5}

offense_type.description: NIBRS offense (the violent/property aggregates and larceny as a whole have no single NIBRS code)

state.description: Optional two-letter state code; omit for national

year.description: Data year (defaults to last calendar year)

total_offenses.description: NIBRS offenses reported in the year

breakdown.description: victim, offender and offense breakdowns; each maps a dimension to {bucket: count}

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Calls /nibrs/{national | state/{state}}/{code} with type=counts and type=totals. NIBRS covers only agencies that report incident-level data.
